milestone.title: fixture/scenario hygiene — drop orphan brownfield-api, flip p3.1-hybrid phase, re-letter code-review lessons

intent.outcome: Test fixtures ship only what consumer tests load, scenarios are marked with the phase their runtime can run, and the L1-L63 lesson anchors still resolve after a reordering.

problem.description: Three fixture/scenario drifts: (a) tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api/ is referenced ONLY in master-plan/milestones/28-green-ci-step-test-backfill-testing-hardening.json:79 text — no integration test loads the fixture, so the M28 claim 'all six fixture projects validated' is half-true. (b) tests/scenarios/p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track/scenario.json is marked phase: implemented while its own notes field reads 'Session milestone under sessions/ is not in Rust path yet — documents target hybrid behavior'; the scenarios_runner refuses to skip it on regression but the path it expects does not exist. (c) crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md entries are not in monotonic L-number order (e.g. L47 precedes L12; L48, L39-L43 interrupted; L15-L21 shuffled); consumers like templates/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md reference ranges like 'L1-L63' that are stable, but skills that point at individual lessons by number may surprise readers.

in_scope: Either delete tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api/ entirely, OR wire it into at least one integration test under crates/mp/tests/brownfield_*.rs that calls mp validate / mp list on it (so the M28 'all six validated' CI claim is real). Update M28 evidence accordingly.

Flip tests/scenarios/p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track/scenario.json to phase: planned and replace its assertions with stdout_contains checks that pass against today's mp behavior; OR land the sessions/ path the notes describe and keep phase: implemented.

Renumber or alphabetize crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md so the L-IDs are monotonically increasing, then update any L\d+ anchor references in templates/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md or in the runnable pattern fixtures that named the old order.
Move (or relabel with a header) the lessons file to make its dual role obvious — it is consumed by the repo-internal mp-code-review skill only, not as a test fixture.
out_of_scope: Rewriting the contents of individual L1-L63 lessons (the syllabus stays as-is).
Refactoring the scenarios_runner to do anything other than skip planned-phase scenarios.

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api is either deleted or loaded by at least one passing integration test, and M28 evidence reflects whichever path was taken.
acceptance_criteria.verification: test ! -e tests/fixtures/projects/brownfield-api || cargo nextest run -p mp --no-fail-fast -E 'test(/brownfield_api/)' (positive; either condition satisfies AC); master-plan/milestones/28-*.json has evidence matching whichever choice was made.

acceptance_criteria.description: tests/scenarios/p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track/scenario.json runs cleanly today (phase matches reality): either marked phase: planned and skipped, or its assertions are realized in code so phase: implemented passes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: cargo nextest run -p mp --test scenarios_runner --no-fail-fast (no regression on p3.1-hybrid-work-next-track scenario).

acceptance_criteria.description: The lessons catalog ids are in monotonically-increasing order and every L\d+ anchor used in templates/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md (or in code_review_patterns.rs) resolves to an actual lesson title.
acceptance_criteria.verification: python3 -c "import re,sys; ids=[int(m.group(1)) for m in re.finditer(r'^## L(\d+)', open('crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md').read(), re.M)]; assert ids == sorted(ids), ids" (exit 0); rg -n '\bL(\d+)\b' templates/skills/mp-code-review/SKILL.md | xargs -I{} rg -q 'L\1' crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md.

acceptance_criteria.description: The lessons file has a one-paragraph header explaining its dual role (test fixture carrying skill content / skill syllabus consumed by an excluded skill), pointing readers to either location.
acceptance_criteria.verification: head -10 crates/mp/tests/fixtures/code-review-lessons.md (or wherever it ends up) includes the paragraph; consumer-surface-lint remains clean (file is under EXCLUDE_PATHS or the relabeled location is also excluded).

work_packages.name: Fixture hygiene
work_packages.goal: Drop the orphan brownfield-api fixture or wire it; flip p3.1-hybrid scenario to its real phase; reletter code-review lessons
work_packages.rollback: Restore the orphan fixture; revert p3.1 phase; revert lesson numbering
